summary: Claude Code is a modular TypeScript/Bun coding-agent runtime with a React terminal UI, remote-session bridge, MCP entrypoints, plugin and skill loading, worktree-aware session setup, and explicit transport and recovery logic.

evidence.reason: Defines the main query loop, task budget accounting, and max_output_tokens recovery behavior.
Coordinates persistent query execution, plugin loading, prompt assembly, and structured output enforcement.
Initializes hooks, file-change watching, worktree creation, tmux sessions, and startup lifecycle behavior.
Implements remote-session orchestration with WebSocket reads, HTTP writes, and permission request callbacks.
Bridges remote permission requests into synthetic assistant messages and local tool stubs.
Provides a serialized hybrid transport with WebSocket reads, POST writes, buffering, and backpressure-aware batching.
Implements resumable SSE transport with sequence tracking and reconnect semantics.
Defines task types spanning local, remote, teammate, workflow, and MCP-monitor execution paths.
Exposes an MCP server entrypoint using the Model Context Protocol SDK.
Shows the repo ships agent-instruction style configuration instead of being instruction-free.
